changes: Added CELLSTYLEMAP to OBJECTS dispatch and a dedicated typed parser with record-state/count/identity validation for cell-style, content, margin, grid, color, handle, and name groups.
Withheld typed callbacks when parser state or versioned style identity is invalid while retaining the full ordered raw DXF object carrier.
Stored CELLSTYLEMAP raw carriers under the existing bounded SORTENTSTABLE/TABLESTYLE raw-record/group/byte budget; typed callback copies remain under CELLSTYLEMAP's existing typed budget.
Extended generated ASCII/Binary output tests to import through dx_iface and assert typed/raw retention plus remapped text-style and linetype references.

remainingLocalWork: Pair DXF-origin typed maps with raw carriers in the rooted graph, verify exact raw/typed identity and projection, and implement generated ASCII/Binary fileExport/readback for the complete owner closure.

researchConclusion.resolved: Generated ASCII and Binary CELLSTYLEMAP objects emitted by the low-level writer can now be imported into both typed records and bounded ordered raw carriers by dx_iface, with handle references preserved.
researchConclusion.unresolved: The graph preflight does not yet admit DXF-origin maps, and no fileExport/readback object-graph roundtrip or independent reader acceptance is proven. The adapter must continue refusing all map exports.
